run_finetune_ocr: run the finetune_ocr script to train a Surya OCR model on an OCR dataset via CLI
build_model_processor: build a SuryaModel and SuryaOCRProcessor from a pretrained checkpoint path
create_ocr_dataset: create a SuryaOCRDataset wrapping a HuggingFace dataset with image preprocessing and script detection
create_data_collator: create a SuryaOCRDataCollator that pads batches and masks special tokens for OCR label generation
test_training_arguments: test the SuryaOCRTrainingArguments dataclass with custom training configuration options
